test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Arrange the sentence parts:

(A) my mother

(B) bought

(C) a beautiful saree

(D) yesterday
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. **ABCD**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "**my mother**," which is correctly indicated by **part (A).**
 
• Following the subject, "**bought**" **(AB)** continues the logical sequence, making it clear what the mother did.
 
• The next part, "**a beautiful saree**," completes the object of the action, indicated by **(C).**
 
• The sentence ends with "**yesterday**," which provides the time of the action, indicated by **(D).**

Therefore, the correct answer is **ABCD.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 2 (CBAD):** This sequence starts with "a beautiful saree," which is not a logical beginning for the sentence. It lacks the subject.
 
• **Option 3 (ACBD):** While it starts with the subject, the sequence "my mother a beautiful saree bought yesterday" is grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 4 (BACD):** Starting with "bought" makes the sentence incomplete as it does not introduce the subject first.
